Principia Metaphysica is a speculative geometric model and has not been peer reviewed.

Assumed. a 26D bulk of signature (24,2): 24 space directions and 2 times, one per shadow, split into two shadows. This is a postulate; nothing below derives it.

Geometry. The internal space of each shadow is Y7, Joyce’s resolution of T7/(ℤ/2)3: a closed manifold with (b2, b3) = (12, 43) and ngen = b2/4 = 3, the number of singular involutions. A metric of holonomy exactly G2 exists by Joyce 2000, Thm 11.6.1: 10 of 10 hypotheses are measured on the active seed and hold (closed by theorem). No explicit metric is claimed; none is known for any compact G2 manifold.

What follows. Read from the topology: the gauge content (CG.5), one K3 surface per singular involution (CG.9) and the effective index χeff = 48n = 144 (the K3 reading; the Euler characteristic of Y7 is 0). Two results are negative: holonomy exactly G2 excludes the confining sector that racetrack stabilisation needs (CG.10), and the leading flux potential cannot accelerate the universe (CG.11).

Against data. Scoreboard: 23 pass, 16 marginal, 10 tension and 28 fail, with chi-squared 2.24e+09 over 66 scored rows. The model does not fit the data globally. Chirality, moduli stabilisation, dark energy and flavour are open.
